entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF8675309. And let me tell you, I've had it. These shoes have given me the worst blisters of my life. I want a full refund, and I want it now!
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble. Just so I'm clear, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or a matter of fit and preference?

What does it matter?! They're garbage! I've tried adjusting the cleats ten different ways, and no matter what, they rub my heel raw. I can't even ride for 10 miles without getting blisters. I want to speak to a manager if you can't process a refund immediately. This is the worst product I've ever bought.

I understand. Dealing with blisters is definitely not what we want for our customers. There's no need for a manager; I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order and confirm the return eligibility. One moment.
You'd better. I'm already writing a one-star review in my head. This is ridiculous.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes was delivered 73 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on this item for up to 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Wait, really? You're just going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just authorized the return. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Once we receive them, we'll process the full refund back to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's... actually what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Again, I'm sorry they didn't work out for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
